name: Do I need a permit to install or replace ceiling beams?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to install or replace ceiling beams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, installing or replacing structural ceiling beams typically requires a building permit from your local jurisdiction. This is because such work impacts the structural integrity of your home and must comply with safety and building codes. Decorative beams that are non-load-bearing generally do not require a permit. Maine Results, Inc. can assist you in understanding the permit requirements for your specific project in areas like Garden City, Meridian, Eagle, Kuna, or Star and will help prepare necessary documentation for submission to ensure compliance and a smooth project start.
acceptedAnswer.description: Structural beam installation usually requires a building permit due to structural impact and code compliance. Decorative beams often do not. We assist with permits.
